**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Offline models
- **Local timeouts now say what actually happened.** When loading an on-device Whisper model or transcribing with it hits the time limit added in 8.21, the error used to show the network message — "over 60 seconds", "check your internet connection". It now reads *Local Model Timeout*, names the real budget, and suggests the fixes that apply: wait for the model to finish compiling, pick a smaller model, or try a shorter recording.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.21...v8.22
